description:
Positioned on top floor (5th) of an intimate gated development within the highly sought-after Shoreditch Triangle, this exceptional three-bedroom, two-bathroom lateral apartment extends to over 1,100 square feet (102.28 square metres), offering beautifully proportioned living space alongside a private balcony and contemporary design features throughout.


Quietly tucked away within a secluded courtyard between the energy of Curtain Road and Shoreditch High Street, the apartment provides a rare sense of calm whilst remaining moments from some of East London's finest restaurants, independent cafés, galleries and creative workspaces.


This is a unique opportunity to acquire a substantial modern home within a well-established development where all apartments were previously retained under single ownership and are now offered for sale under brand new 999-year leases with no ground rent, having recently been refreshed throughout prior to coming to market.


At the heart of the home is an outstanding 22'10 open-plan kitchen, dining and reception room measuring in excess of 500 square feet, creating an exceptional entertaining space rarely found in Shoreditch. Floor-to-ceiling glazing spans the width of the apartment, flooding the room with natural light and providing direct access onto the private balcony, seamlessly extending the living space outdoors.


The contemporary kitchen has been thoughtfully designed with neutral soft-close cabinetry, stone worktops and a full range of integrated Siemens appliances, offering a clean and understated aesthetic. The generous proportions comfortably accommodate separate living, dining and entertaining areas, making the apartment equally suited to everyday living and hosting larger social gatherings.


A particular design feature of this home is the striking exposed timber ceiling, introducing warmth and architectural character that contrasts beautifully with the clean contemporary finishes throughout.

The principal bedroom is exceptionally generous, extending to almost 16ft in length and benefitting from extensive fitted wardrobes and a sleek ensuite shower room. Two further well-proportioned double bedrooms, each measuring in excess of 17ft in length, provide outstanding flexibility for purchasers, whether utilised as additional bedrooms, dedicated home offices, creative workspaces or comfortable guest accommodation. A spacious family bathroom serves the additional bedrooms.


Throughout the apartment, underfloor heating and double-glazed windows provide year-round comfort and excellent energy efficiency, whilst the contemporary interiors have been carefully refreshed to offer a move-in ready home.


Residents benefit from lift access to all floors, a secure video entry system and a covered bicycle store, all within a discreet and well-maintained gated environment. The service charges rather unusually are also inclusive of window cleaning fees and a reserve fund contribution.


Curtain Place occupies an enviable position in the heart of the Shoreditch Triangle, one of East London's most dynamic neighbourhoods. The boutiques and restaurants of Redchurch Street, Shoreditch High Street, Spitalfields and Hoxton are all within easy reach, alongside excellent transport connections via Shoreditch High Street, Old Street, Liverpool Street and Moorgate stations.

Kingsly Estate Agents are delighted to offer to the market this well-presented three-bedroom semi-detached family home situated on the popular Linden Way in Southgate.

The property provides approximately 979 sq ft (90.9 sq m) of internal residential accommodation, excluding the garage, with a total area including the garage of approximately 1,110 sq ft (103 sq m). The accommodation is arranged over two floors and offers generous living space, three well-proportioned bedrooms, a modern fitted kitchen, family bathroom, ground-floor WC, private rear garden, garage and off-street parking.

The ground floor is centred around an impressive through reception room extending to approximately 29'4", providing excellent space for both living and dining areas. The room benefits from good natural light and offers flexible accommodation for family living and entertaining.

To the rear is a modern fitted kitchen with contemporary white units, contrasting work surfaces, integrated cooking facilities and space for appliances. The kitchen overlooks the rear garden and provides direct access outside.

A particularly unusual and enjoyable feature of the property is the garage. Whilst retaining its garage structure and access, the interior has been creatively fitted out as a private climbing and activity area, with extensive climbing holds to the walls and ceiling together with padded flooring. This provides an excellent recreational space for children and climbing enthusiasts and could equally be adapted to suit a purchaser's own requirements.

The first floor provides three bedrooms, including a generous principal bedroom measuring approximately 13'4" x 11'2", together with two further well-proportioned bedrooms and the family bathroom.

Externally, the property benefits from a substantial rear garden measuring approximately 28'6" x 25'6", providing an attractive outside space for entertaining, children and family use. To the front is a paved driveway providing off-street parking and access to the garage.

The property occupies an established residential position in Southgate, with both Southgate and Oakwood Underground stations accessible locally, providing Piccadilly Line connections towards Central London and beyond. Local bus services are also readily available.

Linden Way is conveniently positioned for the shops, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants and other amenities available around Southgate and the surrounding area. Families are also well served by a choice of schools, with Wolfson Hillel Primary School, West Grove Primary and Southgate School amongst those located nearby.

The combination of its three-bedroom accommodation, substantial through reception room, modern kitchen, private garden, off-street parking and distinctive converted garage activity space makes this an appealing family home in a well-connected North London location.

This elegant garden flat is neatly situated on a highly desirable residential road, convenient to Barnes High Street, with shopping at one end, and the delights of the River Thames at the other. Characterful and cosy, it occupies the ground floor of a lovely period building, and has the benefit of a private, enclosed rear garden. Features include exposed wood floors, original fireplaces, bespoke furniture, fitted wardrobe and shelving. There are two double bedrooms, a surprisingly spacious refitted shower room, and to the rear of the property, an open-plan living/dining/kitchen area with attractive flooring opening onto the charming, easily maintained garden.

Lyric Road is an attractive street of mostly Victorian properties, located in the heart of Barnes Village, close to Barnes High Street, the village pond and The River Thames is literally at the end of the road. Barnes Village offers an array of independent boutiques and eateries, as well as some High Street favourites and award-winning restaurants. The village also hosts a weekly Farmers' Market. Convenient transport links are at nearby Barnes and Barnes Bridge stations, which offer frequent service into London Waterloo. There are some excellent schools in the area, including the renowned St Paul's Boys & Juniors, The Harrodian and The Swedish School. Local primary schools are Lowther, St Osmund's and Barnes Primary.

Behind the red-brick façade of this handsome period building, this three-bedroom duplex unfolds across two beautifully proportioned floors, combining dramatic volume with private outdoor space in between Chelsea and South Kensington.



The raised ground floor is devoted to entertaining. A striking double reception stretches the full width of the building, its 11ft ceilings crowned with decorative plasterwork and lit by tall bay windows that draw in the soft light of this quiet Chelsea street. Deep parquet floors run beneath a gallery of framed artworks, while a contemporary fireplace anchors the room and gives it the feel of a private salon rather than a conventional living space.



To the rear, the kitchen and dining room form a generous open-plan sequence, where sleek cabinetry and a long island sit beneath a wall of windows and doors opening directly onto the terrace. This elevated outdoor space becomes an extension of the kitchen, perfect for summer lunches, evening drinks or simply letting the day spill outside. A guest cloakroom and discreet storage complete this level.



Downstairs, the mood shifts to something calmer and more private. The principal bedroom suite is generously scaled, with bespoke wardrobes and an ensuite bathroom finished in pale stone, complete with a deep bathtub and walk-in shower. Two further bedrooms sit alongside a second bathroom, one of them opening directly onto a secluded private garden that brings greenery and light deep into the lower floor. Vault storage adds a practical touch without compromising the clean lines of the rooms.



Throughout, the apartment balances contemporary finishes with the character of its period features, giving it a sense of individuality that feels far removed from a standard Chelsea conversion.



Draycott Place is defined by its elegant red-brick buildings, mature trees and its sense of calm. The boutiques and cafés of the King’s Road and Pavilion Road are moments away, Sloane Square station is close at hand, and Hyde Park provides a welcome sweep of green just up the road.

Guide Price £325,000-£350,000. Welcome to Passfields – a distinctive Grade II listed development where award-winning post-war architecture meets modern-day living. Positioned on the second floor, this three-bedroom apartment extends to approx. 824 sq ft and features two private balconies. New lease of 171 years on completion.

Passfields was designed to maximise light and open space and was recognised with a Festival of Britain Merit Award in 1951, giving the development an architectural identity that sets it apart.

A 19'2" entrance hallway connects the accommodation and leads into the reception room, where large windows provide plenty of natural light, with ample room for both sitting and dining. A door opens directly onto the larger of the two balconies, with an elevated outlook across the surrounding greenery.

The fitted kitchen has contemporary muted-green cabinets, integrated appliances, work surfaces and contrasting tiled splashbacks. A glazed door opens onto the second balcony, bringing further natural light into the room and providing another area of private outdoor space.

There are three bedrooms comprising two doubles and a single. The second double is currently arranged as a home office, illustrating the flexibility of the layout for guests, children or those working from home. The bathroom is fitted with a bath and overhead shower, wash basin and WC.

Light flooring, white walls and large windows contribute to the bright and airy feel throughout. Ideal for first-time buyers, families or investors, this is an opportunity to own a three-bedroom home within one of Catford's most distinctive residential developments.
